recipe.prompt: A professional scientific infographic diagram for an academic paper, showing the key molecular conclusions of a meiosis initiation switch study. Clean white background with a modern journal-quality layout (Nature/Cell style). The central visual is a layered framework diagram titled 'DCT-M3: Meiosis Initiation Switch Molecular Architecture'. Four colored horizontal layers from top to bottom: 1) 'Permissive Licensing' (blue) - chromatin opening, epigenetic priming, competence establishment; 2) 'Brake Release' (orange) - degradation of meiotic inhibitors, ubiquitin-proteasome pathway; 3) 'Trigger Execution' (red) - SPO11-mediated double-strand breaks, meiotic recombination initiation, synaptonemal complex assembly; 4) 'Chromatin/RNA Competence' (green) - transcriptional program activation, splicing regulation, 3D genome reorganization. To the right side, a summary panel: 'Candidate Gene Atlas: 23 genes across 12 molecular classes' with small gene symbol tags. Bottom section shows integrated evidence icons: transcriptomics, epigenomics, proteomics, AlphaFold3 structural prediction, literature evidence. Title at top: 'Molecular Conclusions: The Meiosis Initiation Switch'. Kept strictly as a clean scientific diagram with sharp vector-like appearance, no photo-realistic elements, professional typography, suitable for print publication at high resolution.
